checks.source_year_conclusion: The exact report member frozen in the 2022 ESEF revision-1 package visibly contains the DGB 2023 annual report, 2023 financial statements and a Board declaration dated 29 February 2024. Its embedded XBRL entity contexts still encode 2022 and the archive/report basename says 2022. Thus this is a genuine within-file narrative/tagging mismatch, not merely a cover typo or extraction-spacing defect. The selected 2022-period source cannot be established as readable 2022 narrative evidence from these bytes. Keep primary assessment unresolved; do not recode the selected year to 2023 or use this later narrative as 2022 follow-up.

checks.column_conclusion: Both extracted text versions retain physical-row interleaving across columns/spread pages. The block-aware extraction fixes inline-word spacing but not column order. CSS coordinates establish separate column continuations. On printed page 59 the AI sentence is an industry/competitive-risk statement ending that online networks such as ad pepper may in future lose further relevance or their business basis. Interleaved fraud, ESG and personnel lines must not be attached to it. On printed page 46, the Webgains paragraph is separate from the neighbouring iLead/ad pepper paragraph. Its claim about the optimum blend of human and artificial intelligence is already present on original-report printed page 46; its coexistence with Affiliate Discovery and The Tag does not itself explicitly identify those named tools as AI functions.
